Ruth, I replied in the #strategic-pod thread. Two of the four owners are firm; Orlavine is my inference and Quillfeather is unconfirmed.

- **Vantorre Group:** Gideon Sato. It changed hands from Nadia Fennimore on **2026-05-04**. The 5/3 digest says it changes hands "tomorrow, 2026-05-04", and the 5/4 digest confirms the CRM reassignment that day.
- **Vantorre Mobility:** Gideon Sato. The 5/4 digest says he "also assumed management" that day. Earlier digests already call it Gideon's fleet account, so the 5/4 wording is odd.
- **Orlavine Medical Supply:** Gideon Sato, inferred. The digests only say "Gideon's medical account" and never name Orlavine. The March 2025 digest called it Nadia's medical account, so it moved at some point, with no date given. Check this one before it goes on the slide.
- **Quillfeather Outfitters:** The digests don't name an owner. They only call it the pod's outdoor or retail account. Nadia volunteers to run a training session in the 9/30 digest, but that doesn't make her the owner.

I used only the Strategic digests. I couldn't find any account or CRM files in what I can read, so I had nothing to settle Orlavine or Quillfeather.
